literal_meaning: মনে (in the mind) আসা (to come) / করা (to do)
figurative_meaning_en: to come to mind or to remember
example_sentences_in_bangla: মনে আসছে না তোমাকে কি বলেছি।
example_sentences_in_english: I can't remember what I told you.
note: This idiom is a common expression in everyday Bengali speech for recalling or failing to recall something.
